title: MorphField R2 offline schema bundle
description: A deterministic compound schema document. Embedded resources retain their canonical absolute $id values and resolve without network access.

benchmark-receipt.title: MorphField R2 benchmark receipt
benchmark-receipt.description: A portable benchmark snapshot. Timing channels remain explicitly sourced; queue-completion wall time is not GPU shader time.

common.title: MorphField R2 common canonical JSON definitions
common.description: Definitions shared by canonical semantic MorphField JSON. Runtime-only GPU objects and binary ABI records are intentionally outside this data model.

nexel-capabilities.title: MorphField R2 Nexel capability profile
nexel-capabilities.description: An honest, versioned declaration of semantic admission, compilation, CPU reference, GPU query, and renderer coverage by source kind.

nexel.title: MorphField R2 canonical Nexel descriptor
nexel.description: A device-independent semantic Nexel after runtime normalization. Backend/family selection and authored certificates are intentionally absent.

particle-chain-simulation.title: MorphField particle-chain Nexel snapshot metadata
particle-chain-simulation.description: The canonical simulation metadata emitted by createParticleChainNexelDescriptors(). Solver state remains caller-owned and is not embedded here.

patch.title: MorphField R2 canonical Nexel patch
patch.description: A normalized monotonic scene patch. Ordering, duplicate IDs, skipped revisions, and stale revisions remain runtime invariants.

provenance.title: MorphField R2 asset provenance
provenance.description: Canonical, bounded JSON metadata stored in a .morph PROV chunk. The codec injects and validates the contract-identification fields for object payloads supplied through encodeAsset().

scene.title: MorphField R2 canonical Nexel scene
scene.description: The authoritative semantic manifest serialized by NexelScene and stored in the MANF chunk of a .morph asset.

source.title: MorphField R2 canonical Nexel source
source.description: The nine semantic source kinds admitted by the R2 compiler. Certificates and execution-family selections are compiler-owned and are deliberately absent.

validation-report.title: MorphField R2 validation report
validation-report.description: The exported result of the browser-native MorphField verification console.
